description: This source file defines the ResourceBundleMapWrapper class, which wraps a ResourceBundle to allow its use as a Map. It provides mechanisms to stack resource bundles, retrieve values with optional string expansion, and manage resource bundle layers. It also contains an internal wrapper class for individual resource bundles.

classes.name: ResourceBundleMapWrapper
classes.description: A Map wrapper for ResourceBundle that supports stacking multiple ResourceBundles and value expansion.

classes.name: ResourceBundleMapWrapper.InternalRbmWrapper
classes.description: Internal class representing a single ResourceBundle layer within the wrapper, allowing lazy initialization of its key-value map.

methods.name: ResourceBundleMapWrapper
methods.description: Constructs a new ResourceBundleMapWrapper with an initial ResourceBundle or an internal wrapper.

methods.name: addBottomResourceBundle
methods.description: Adds a resource bundle or internal wrapper to the bottom of the stack.

methods.name: pushResourceBundle
methods.description: Pushes a resource bundle on top of the stack, overriding lower layers.

methods.name: getInitialResourceBundle
methods.description: Returns the initial resource bundle provided during construction.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all layers in the stack.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the layered resource bundles.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns a set view of the map's entries.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value for a key, expanding strings if a context is set.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the stack is empty.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns a set of all keys.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds or updates a key-value pair in the top layer.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Adds all entries from the provided map into the top layer.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an entry for a key.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a collection of all values.
